title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 24-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Mambo Collection Allied Brass
description:
Add dependable towel storage with a 24-Inch wall mount towel bar made from solid brass. This piece coordinates with the mambo collection for matching mambo layouts and statement bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Wall-mounted towel rack / towel holder style helps save floor space
- Available in a wide variety of designer finish options
- Includes mounting plates and all installation hardware

Specs:
- Product type: towel bar (straight bar)
- Center-to-center: 24 in
- Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Overall dimensions: 25 in W x 3 in H; projection: 3 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Great for shoppers seeking designer bath accessories, designer bathroom hardware, textured bathroom hardware, and statement bath accessories.
